items.title: Microsoft jumps 8% as it boosts capital spending plans, citing demand

items.title: Reddit CEO says Google's AI Overviews can't replace '10 blue links' for referral traffic

items.title: Amazon's AWS posts fastest growth since 2021, citing AI and chip demand

items.title: Mark Zuckerberg is Trying to Compete With Everyone, Says Laura Martin
items.title_ko: Mark Zuckerberg는 모든 사람과 경쟁하려고 노력하고 있다고 Laura Martin은 말합니다.
